summary: __stdcall allocation wrapper: calls OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper with the requested size a1, stores the returned pointer through the caller-provided output parameter a2, and returns whether the allocation succeeded (pointer non-null). Lets callers that must grow or reallocate buffers detect allocation failure.

operations.description: Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(a1) to allocate the requested bytes, capturing the resulting pointer into the local v2.
Store the allocation result v2 through the output parameter a2 so the caller receives the new pointer.
Return the success flag computed as (v2 != 0); a zero pointer reports allocation failure.

unresolved: The object type allocated for a1 bytes and how each caller interprets the success flag are not determinable from this packet.
